label: Non-heldout post-feedback iteration; excluded from the frozen first-pass comparison
scope: Only the two observed case-c C searches with polarity defects rerun, with their original briefs unchanged. No new renders, selections, aesthetic scores, corpus changes, or model/index changes.

before_interpretation.name_lookup_advice: query ranks preferences and can return alternatives when a name is absent. Use family for a hard exact family-name lookup.
before_interpretation.unmodeled_terms_meaning: Terms not interpreted by deterministic aliases. The active visual adapter may interpret their appearance; inspect its evidence and render finalists.
before_interpretation.negation_scope: Negation extends across coordinated terms until punctuation or an explicit contrast such as but. Ambiguous prose should be rewritten or checked against these reported terms.
before_interpretation.method: Negation-aware aliases, literal name matches, measured context preferences, and optional content-based visual evidence. Unmodeled terms are not interpreted by metadata ranking; a visual adapter may interpret them. unrecognized brief fields have no effect.

after_interpretation.unmodeled_terms_meaning: Terms not interpreted by deterministic aliases. The active visual adapter may interpret their appearance; inspect its evidence and render finalists.
after_interpretation.negation_scope: Query and tone are interpreted independently. Negation extends across comma-coordinated terms until a sentence/semicolon/colon boundary, an explicit contrast such as but, or a comma-led positive clause such as prefer or use. Check the reported polarity for ambiguous prose.
after_interpretation.method: Negation-aware aliases, literal name matches, measured context preferences, and optional content-based visual evidence. Unmodeled terms are not interpreted by metadata ranking; a visual adapter may interpret them. unrecognized brief fields have no effect.
